newsitem.title: USA: IPO HIGHLIGHTS - Forrester jumps in debut.
newsitem.headline: IPO HIGHLIGHTS - Forrester jumps in debut.

text.p: Shares of Forrester Research Inc sprung as much as 35 percent higher Wednesday in the company's first day of trading after its initial public offering.
The shares opened at 21-3/4, up 5-3/4 from an IPO price of 16 and reached as high as 22-3/8. Forrester sold about a 25 percent stake to the public, or about 2 million shares.
Analysts had expected the deal to be hot. Forrester is a leading independent research company offering products and services that help its clients assess the effect of technology on their businesses.
Other issues that made their market debuts included:
* Genesis Energy Corp units inched up 1/4 to 20-7/8 after its IPO. Salomon Inc and Howell Corp offered 7.5 million common units of Genesis, an oil-gathering and pipeline company based in Houston.
The two companies formed Genesis to buy, own and operate the businesses of Howell and Basis Petroleum, a Salomon unit, that gather and distribute crude oil.
The units were offered at $20.625 each. About 68.18 percent of effective ownership of Genesis was offered.
